item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 09/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. An upper-air disturbance will bring unsettled weather to Guangdong over the weekend.

Date/Month: 09/05 (Tuesday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two showers.
Temp range: 22 - 25 C
R.H. range: 75 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 10/05 (Wednesday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers.
